summary: Custom shell plugins go in a shell_plugins directory next to the play, in a role or in a configured path. You should only change the shell plugin if /bin/sh is not POSIX-compatible or not available.
questions: When should I change the shell plugin Ansible uses?
My target has no POSIX /bin/sh. What do I do?
Where do custom shell plugins go?

answer_card.title: Adding or changing shell plugins
answer_card.answer_md:
Put custom shell plugins in a `shell_plugins` directory next to your play, in a role, or in a configured shell plugin directory.

Only change the plugin if the target's `/bin/sh` is not POSIX-compatible or can't be executed.
